en-US.description:
Scoreboard! turns your phone into a clean, readable scoreboard for the game in front of you.

Pick a sport, name the teams, and start counting. No account, no sign-up, no setup.

FOUR SPORTS
Soccer, basketball, volleyball and badminton. Basketball gets one, two and three point buttons. Volleyball ends at 25 and badminton at 21, both win-by-two, with badminton capped at 30 the way a real game is.

BUILT TO BE READ ACROSS A PITCH
Big landscape scores, high contrast, and team panels you tap anywhere to score.

MAKE IT YOUR MATCH
Rename Home and Away to the actual teams, and pick each side's colour from eight presets.

A REAL WHISTLE
Hold the whistle button to blow for as long as you need, so a full-time short-short-long sounds right. It works with the ringer switch off, because that is where phones live courtside.

NOTHING IS COLLECTED
No accounts, no analytics, no tracking, and no network access. Scores live on your phone for as long as the match does.
